title: The Fragility of Reasoning-Importance Attribution for Pruning Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.22234v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Attribution-guided pruning scores components by their causal contribution and protects the important ones, and it is increasingly applied to compress reasoning language models without destroying their chain of thought. Its reliability rests on an unexamined assumption: that reasoning importance can be faithfully measured. Across four small reasoning models, we show this measurement is fragile in three ways, each of which changes pruning decisions. First, scoring final-answer tokens, the natural choice, saturates in every chain-of-thought model we test (answer-token negative log-likelihood, NLL, of $10^{-4}$--$10^{-3}$) because the model states its answer inside its own reasoning; guiding head pruning with this target costs 27.6 and 32.2 accuracy points relative to scoring reasoning tokens on the two models we power with five seeds, while perplexity barely moves and even reverses sign at 7B. translated_title: 语言模型剪枝中推理重要性归因的脆弱性
translated_abstract: 基于归因引导的剪枝方法通过评估各组件的因果贡献来为其打分，并保护其中重要的组件，该方法正日益被用于压缩推理语言模型而不破坏其思维链。其可靠性建立在一个未经检验的假设之上：即推理重要性能够被忠实地度量。在四个小型推理模型上，我们证明了这种度量在三个方面是脆弱的，而每一方面都会改变剪枝决策。第一，对最终答案token打分——这是最自然的选择——在我们测试的每一个思维链模型中都会饱和（答案token的负对数似然NLL仅为10^{-4}–10^{-3}），因为模型会在自身的推理过程中陈述答案；在我们以五个随机种子进行功效分析的两个模型上，以该目标引导注意力头剪枝，相比对推理token打分会损失27.6和32.2个准确率百分点，而困惑度却几乎不变，甚至在7B模型上符号反转。第二，因果重要性无法被定位到……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文揭示了推理语言模型剪枝所依赖的“推理重要性归因”度量是脆弱的——对最终答案token打分因饱和而失效，会导致剪枝后准确率大幅下降，动摇了归因引导剪枝方法的基础假设。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that reasoning-importance attribution—the foundation of attribution-guided pruning for reasoning language models—is fragile, as final-answer token scoring saturates and misguides pruning, causing accuracy drops of up to 32.2 points.
